Senses.PreferredTarget: a bright pearl held in the palm

Occurrences.Kwic: 以今世人輕賤故，先世罪業則為消滅。雪竇顯頌云：明珠在掌，有功者賞。胡漢不來，全無伎倆。伎倆既無，波旬失途。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X83/X83n1578.xml). Record Pointing at the Moon (指月錄). Speaker: Xuedou Chongxian.

Occurrences.Kwic: 一點也瞞他不得。這箇却不是世諦情見。如明鏡當臺。明珠在掌。胡來胡現。漢來漢現。是他知有向上事。所以如此。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (T/T48/T48n2003.xml). Blue Cliff Record by Chan Master Yuanwu Foguo (佛果圜悟禪師碧巖錄). Speaker: Yuanwu Keqin.

Occurrences.Kwic: 作麼生。但願春風齊著力。一時吹入此中來。復頌云。明珠在掌。有功者賞。長老新入院。都盧無伎倆。不立趙州關。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (T/T47/T47n1997.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yuanwu Foguo (圓悟佛果禪師語錄). Speaker: Yuanwu Keqin.

Occurrences.Kwic: 喚作釋迦老子，一舉四十九。恕中慍禪師佛誕，上堂：明珠在掌，隨眾色以分輝；寶月當空，逐千江而現影。拈拄杖：
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X64/X64n1260.xml). Outline Record of the Successive Patriarchs (列祖提綱錄). Speaker: Shuzhong Wen.

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: Shuzhong Wen 恕中慍: The section names Shuzhong Wen and 上堂 begins his Buddha-birthday address pairing the pearl in hand with the moon in space.

Senses.Explanation: A pearl already lying in the palm is something immediately available and responsive to what appears. Xuedou links possession with earned reward; Yuanwu compares encounter to mirror and pearl; Shuzhong has the pearl cast its colors on whatever appears before it.
